question: To which revilers of sacred figures must the teaching never be given?
premises: A reviler of Shiva is named
A reviler of Kula Bhairava is named
inference: The teaching must not be given to revilers of Shiva or Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may refer to Bhairava of the Kula or the Kula and Bhairava
plain_english: O goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Shiva, to a slanderer, or to one who reviles Kula Bhairava.
